ObServe is the data source; ROS is the reporting workbook.

The first target is the longline form 4.2.0. Each selected trip produces one workbook.

The workflow is: select trips, read their data, resolve correspondences, fill the form, then validate it.

The reviews identify available data and open decisions. They do not establish a complete working exporter.

[Detailed review](../ros.form.observe.html) · [Short review index](../06-source-coverage/ll-sheet-summaries.html).
